name: ElevenLabs wordmark-over-warped-grid OG card by elevenlabs.io
description: A 1200×630 social card built around a single focal element: the "ElevenLabs" wordmark with its "II" two-bar glyph, set in a tight-tracked bold grotesque at display size, near-black (#191919), straddling the horizontal midline. Behind it, a warm off-white field (#F5F4F1) is covered in hairline gray (#D9D7D1) lines that undulate like distorted graph paper, denser toward the edges and corners and softened by a radial fade so a quiet glow sits behind the type. Monochrome in three inks — field, black wordmark, gray pattern — with no headline, URL, imagery or secondary focal point; the wordmark alone carries the card and the warped mesh is pure texture.
